Flawless service and a convenient location 1.4 miles from the historic Buddhist temple "One Pillar Pagoda" make the Hanoi hostel a great place to stay. Location The hostel is situated approximately 25 minutes' walk from the circa-1900s Colonial Presidential Palace and within reach of such educational sites as the corporate BIDV Tower Campus. Also, Hanoi New Comb hostel is 1.5 miles from such natural sights as the shaded park "Hanoi Botanical Garden". Guests will find the colourful Hanoi Ceramic Mosaic Mural, which is just 5 minutes' walk away. Food & Drinks Guests can dine in Banh Mi 25 in the vicinity of the Hanoi hostel. This Hanoi property is 0.3 miles from to airport number 86 bus station and 1.3 miles from Ha Noi train station.
